title: Introducing the Repaint Platform
summary: Repaint now has built-in payments, email, customer accounts, and data storage, so it can build software for your business like online stores and booking systems.
body_markdown:
### Overview


Today, we're releasing our biggest update yet. Repaint now has built-in payment processing, email sending, customer accounts, and data storage. With these tools, it can build much more advanced software for your business, like online stores, booking systems, and membership programs. You just describe what you need in the chat, the same way you'd build a website.


We're also updating our pricing. There are now three subscription tiers, from $25 to $200 per month, each with higher usage limits. We're replacing the permanent free plan with a two-week free trial, so we can offer more capable AI models to everyone sustainably. Existing subscriptions keep the same price and billing schedule.


### What's new


We've given Repaint new tools to help you run your business:


-


**Payment Processing** - Accept cards and other payment methods directly on your website.


-


**Email Sending** - Send emails to your customers, like order confirmations, appointment reminders, or a newsletter they signed up for.


-


**Customer Accounts** - Let customers sign in to your website, so each person can see their own orders, bookings, or members-only content.


-


**Data Storage** - Save any information your business needs to keep track of.


-


**Custom Dashboards** - Create internal admin panels to view analytics about your business and make changes to your data.


-


**Scheduled Tasks** - Set up tasks that run automatically on a schedule, like sending a reminder the day before an appointment.


Repaint's AI can use all of these tools, so you can just tell it what you want. It can also help you design your system.


### What's possible


With these building blocks, Repaint can make systems for a wide range of businesses. Common ones include:


-


**Online Stores** - Sell physical or digital products, with a cart, checkout, and a place to track and fulfill orders.


-


**Booking Systems** - Let customers book an appointment or sign up for a class, based on the availability you set.


-


**Membership Programs** - Charge a recurring subscription and give members access to private content or perks.


-


**Online Courses** - Sell courses with lessons your students can work through at their own pace.


-


**Custom Apps** - Build software around how your business works, like a client portal or an internal tool for your team.


If you already have a website in Repaint, you can add any of these to it.


### New plans and pricing


Repaint now has three monthly plans: Plus, Pro, and Max. All of them include the full platform. The higher plans come with higher limits, most importantly on how much you can use the AI each week.

We're replacing the permanent free plan with a 14-day free trial, which lets us offer more capable AI models to everyone. The trial includes the full platform, so you can build and publish before choosing a plan.


When your website takes payments, card processing costs 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction in the US, and[varies by country](https://repaint.com/help/payment-fees) . You can find the full details on the[pricing page](https://repaint.com/pricing) .


### What changes for existing accounts


**If you have a subscription.** It keeps renewing at the same price and billing schedule for as long as you keep it, including annual plans and the $50 Pro plan, which we no longer sell. If you cancel, the old plan can't be restarted. Workspace seats and custom domains now have limits. If you're already over one, you keep what you have, but adding more requires upgrading.


**If you were on the free plan.** Your account moved to a 14-day free trial on the day of this launch. When the trial ends, your workspace pauses and your published websites go offline until you choose a plan. Your work stays saved in your account. When you start a plan, your workspace unpauses and your websites go back online.


The update is live for everyone today in[Repaint](https://repaint.com/) .
